findings.documented: Every request must carry API key as query parameter: GET /v1/listings?api_key=IVY26-XXXXXXXXXXXX
findings.actual: API rejects query parameter with 401 'send your key in the X-API-Key request header, not as a query parameter'. Header X-API-Key is mandatory.
findings.how_found: Initial HTTP GET request with ?api_key= in query string returned 401 Unauthorized with header instructions.
findings.impact: All frontend/API client requests fail unless migrated to X-API-Key request header.

findings.documented: Returns 'token' string valid for 86400 seconds (24 hours) with no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns 'access_token' and 'refresh_token' fields with expires_in=900 seconds (15 minutes) and refresh_url='/auth/refresh'.
findings.how_found: Inspected response body structure of POST /auth/login.
findings.impact: Frontend reading 'token' field gets undefined and user session expires in 15 mins instead of 24 hrs.

findings.documented: Public listings browsing requires only api_key parameter without user login.
findings.actual: All /v1/ collection endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <access_token> header or return 401 missing bearer token.
findings.how_found: Requested /v1/listings with X-API-Key header but no Bearer token.
findings.impact: Unauthenticated visitors cannot browse property listings; login is strictly mandatory for all endpoints.

findings.actual: Server hard-caps returned results array to maximum 50 records per page even when limit=200 is passed.
findings.how_found: Requested /v1/listings?page=1&limit=200 and observed exactly 50 records returned.
findings.impact: Full data retrieval requires 4x more API HTTP roundtrips than documented.

findings.documented: GET /v1/analytics/summary provides pre-computed aggregates for city dashboard.
findings.actual: Endpoint does not exist and returns HTTP 404 'Not Found'.
findings.how_found: Sent GET request to /v1/analytics/summary with valid key and token.
findings.impact: City analytics dashboard cannot fetch server pre-aggregates and must compute metrics client-side.

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique, and each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Endpoint returns 4000 total records, which consist of only 50 unique listing_ids duplicated 80 times across pages.
findings.how_found: Paged through all 4000 records and grouped by listing_id.
findings.impact: Un-deduplicated property lists present 80 duplicate cards per property to buyers.

findings.documented: Area: Square feet, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Listings MAG-4003885, MAG-4002264, MAG-4003492, MAG-4000039 provide carpet_area in square meters (e.g. 111, 86, 100, 144 sq.m), causing impossible room sizes (<40 sqft/room) if read as sqft.
findings.how_found: Scanned carpet area to bedroom ratio across all listing records.
findings.impact: Price per sqft calculations and unit filters produce wild outliers unless converted (x 10.7639).

findings.documented: Money in Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: price_min and price_max in /v1/projects are floating point values in Lakhs (>=10) or Crores (<10) (e.g. 66.1 Lakhs, 1.95 Crores) instead of integer rupees.
findings.impact: Formatting as integer rupees displays project price as ₹66 instead of ₹66,10,000.

findings.documented: total_listings is recomputed whenever a listing is added or withdrawn so it always agrees with GET /v1/listings?project_id=...
findings.actual: total_listings reported by 43 out of 50 projects contradicts the actual number of active listings associated with that project_id.
findings.how_found: Cross-referenced project_id counts in /v1/listings against total_listings in /v1/projects.
findings.impact: Project detail cards display inaccurate available unit counts.

findings.documented: project_id links listing to builder project, null for resale property not part of one.
findings.actual: 37 listing records reference project_id strings (e.g. P40244, P40142, P40262) that do not exist in the /v1/projects database.
findings.how_found: Cross-referenced all project_ids in /v1/listings against /v1/projects list (P40001-P40050).
findings.impact: Clicking project links on detail pages leads to 404 project not found errors.

findings.documented: Listings contain accurate bedroom and physical property specifications.
findings.actual: Listing SQU-4002903 reports bedroom=0 and bathroom=0 while described as a residential plot/home in Tambaram.
findings.how_found: Filtered listings for bedroom <= 0 or bathroom <= 0.
findings.impact: Causes zero-division or crash in property recommendation engines.

findings.documented: Active sale listings in your city.
findings.actual: Listing SQU-4001315 is a clickbait fake listing priced at ₹28.10 Lakhs (60% below market average for Adyar 2BHKs) with text 'Price negotiable for quick sale' and invalid project reference.
findings.how_found: Analyzed price per sqft ratio and description anomalies across Adyar listings.
findings.impact: Bait-and-switch listing to harvest buyer lead contacts.
